author: Praxis IV
title: Idea 3: Mutual‑k enforcement with distance-only top‑up to k=50 (PCA60, cosine)
abstract: Keep mutual edges (A ∩ Aᵀ) from directed kNN in PCA60 space, then top up to degree k by nearest true distances from the union of in/out candidates; binary connectivities + true distances. Hypothesis: reduce unilateral hub-induced edges without quotas on the simple baseline.
